package wasi:clocks@0.2.3;

interface wasi-clocks-wall-clock {
  record wasi-datetime {
    seconds: u64,
    nanoseconds: u32,
  }

  now: func() -> wasi-datetime;
  resolution: func() -> wasi-datetime;
}

world wasi-clocks-wall-clock {
  export wasi-clocks-wall-clock;
}

package wasi:clocks@0.2.3;

interface wasi-clocks-monotonic-clock {
  now: func() -> u64;
  resolution: func() -> u64;
  subscribe-instant: func(when: u64) -> own<pollable>;
}

world wasi-clocks-monotonic-clock {
  export wasi-clocks-monotonic-clock;
}

package wasi:io@0.2.3;

interface wasi-io-poll {
  resource pollable;

  pollable-ready: func(self: borrow<pollable>) -> bool;
  pollable-block: func(self: borrow<pollable>);
  poll: func(in: list<borrow<pollable>>) -> list<u32>;
}

world wasi-io-poll {
  export wasi-io-poll;
}
---- constexpr interface_text
interface wasi-io-poll {
  resource pollable;

  pollable-ready: func(self: borrow<pollable>) -> bool;
  pollable-block: func(self: borrow<pollable>);
  poll: func(in: list<borrow<pollable>>) -> list<u32>;
}

interface wasi-io-poll {

  }

  pollable-block: func(self: u32);
  poll: func(in: list<u32>) -> list<u32>;

---- generate_wit_text
package wasi:io@0.2.3;

interface wasi-io-streams {
  resource input-stream;

  read: func(self: borrow<input-stream>, len: u64) -> list<u8>;
  subscribe: func(self: borrow<input-stream>) -> own<pollable>;
  drop: func(self: own<input-stream>);
}

world wasi-io-streams {
  export wasi-io-streams;
}
---- constexpr interface_text

  drop: func(self: own<input-stream>);
}

package wasi_io@0.2.3;

interface wasi-io-streams {
  resource input-stream {
  }

  subscribe: func(self: u32) -> u32;
  drop: func(self: u32);
}
